# A classic console window with a command prompt whose prompt is ">".
# Nothing is ever entered: the line is cleared with Esc at the end.
layout:en
wait:800
type:ghbdtn
tap:alt
show
contains:>привет
# The layout is Russian now: the same keys type Russian letters.
type:\sghbdtn
contains:>привет привет
tap:alt
contains:>привет ghbdtn
type:\sok
contains:>привет ghbdtn ok
tap:ctrl
contains:>привет ghbdtn OK
tap:ctrl
contains:>привет ghbdtn ok
key:esc
